name: PipRail
description: Backendless, no-fee x402 SDK and MCP server. Take or make agent payments across 28 chains in 10 families (every major EVM chain plus Solana, TON, Tron, NEAR, Sui, Aptos, Algorand, Stellar & XRPL). Self-custodial — the payer broadcasts their own transfer, verified locally against your own RPC, no facilitator.
